citation: '58. Clark street, North from Washington.' Stereograph from Carbutt's Views of Chicago, c. 1866-1871. New York Public Library, Robert N. Dennis collection of stereoscopic views, MFY Dennis Coll 90-F179 (digital ID G90F179_011F).
author: unattributed on the mount (the series is catalogued with Carbutt's Views of Chicago)
repository: New York Public Library, Miriam and Ira D. Wallach Division of Art, Prints and Photographs: Photography Collection; catalog record b11707456.
locator: Clark Street north from Washington beside the Court House square: a pale stone five-storey front with an arched ground floor and a lettered frieze, attached brick fronts, awnings.
rights_note: Created before 1871; public domain. NYPL marks the Dennis collection 'No known copyright restrictions'. Read for period forms only; no pixels are sampled and no geometry is traced.
access_notes: Read 2026-11-19 (T-3686) from NYPL's image server, digital ID G90F179_011F.
note: A street view, not a survey: it shows how the pre-fire business streets and residential blocks were built, not the fronts of the generated lots.
what_it_supplies: pale stone and brick attached fronts on Clark Street by the Court House square
lettered friezes and signboards, arched ground floors, awnings
what_it_does_not_supply: the identity or dimensions of any generated front
